methodology.snapshot: Original ghat/22-beach description cutoff: 10 November 2026. Added-beach identity research and coverage expansion: 11 November 2026. Provider caches retain actual retrieval timestamps; composed caches identify their assembly date and source legs. No retrieval or assembly certifies current road conditions.
methodology.coverage: Complete itinerary coverage of the 19 explicitly enumerated confirmed documented-road baseline corridors. This is not a universal discovery or current-opening claim. Proposed/unconfirmed direct links and historic walking passes are individually dispositioned. Destination coverage: 38 distinct beaches, ten per supported ghat and five distinct primary corridors per beach. 82 original itineraries for supported ghats retain their exact geometry, metrics and provenance. Destination expansion researched 11 November 2026: 38 distinct beaches, ten per ghat and five distinct primary corridors per beach; original descriptive cutoff and 82 original itineraries for supported ghats retained.
methodology.routing: Finite one-time curated requests, one connection, >=1.25s between requests, identified application User-Agent, persistent response cache. No API at application runtime.
methodology.origin: Car-network reference adjacent to the landmark, not inside the monument. Desk-verified by OSRM snap; no on-site access check.
methodology.endpoints: Same frozen origin and one fixed beach road-arrival point per destination. Named anchor/town locations are OSM-snapped road references, not promises of visitor parking or stopping permission.
methodology.geometry: Road-following full OSRM response retained in cache; display simplification never joins the seed points as substitute roads. Ordered entry/interior/exit anchors audited, all waypoints retained. No Google-derived geometry.
methodology.ghatLength: Anchor-defined segment length from OSRM legs, not the full itinerary and not a universal ghat boundary. Elevation is unknown; no peak elevations substituted.

difficulty.rubric: Sample the returned full ghat-section road line every100m; count direction changes >=35 degrees. Turns per10km: <10 gives1, 10–<20 gives2, 20–<30 gives3, 30–<40 gives4, >=40 gives5. Thresholds are disclosed editorial categories, not a calibrated engineering standard.
difficulty.description: Measures steering/curvature demand only. Does not infer lane width, surface, gradients, traffic, weather, legal access, driver ability or safety. Statistics and sampling parameters are retained per section.
difficulty.routeAggregation: Maximum curves-only rating across named traversed ghat sections; not an assessment of every kilometre of the journey.

scenery.rubric: 1 utilitarian corridor; 2 limited documented landscape interest; 3 mixed transport corridor and documented mountain/forest setting; 4 documented forest/mountain road attraction; 5 dedicated official ghat attraction with documented waterfall/escarpment setting. Null when descriptive evidence is insufficient.
scenery.routeAggregation: Uses selected ghat corridor rating only, not a claim about every kilometre of the full journey. No safety assurance.

scoring.tolls: Unknown. Absence of a sourced toll amount is not a zero-toll claim. If toll weight is active, ranking must remain explicitly incomplete; do not silently substitute zero.

methodology.seasons: Monsoon landscape references are not recommendations to drive during storms. No active closure/weather/access verification.
knownLimitations: The confirmed documented-road baseline is explicit and finite, not a claim of universal discovery.
The Namkhol spur and Mangeli border-road completion are separately blocked link claims; no geometry invented.
Car routing is a static graph model, not verification of a legally open road today.
No elevation/toll measurements or whole-road safety assessment; difficulty is only a geometry-derived editorial curves proxy.

nearestBeaches.profile: FOSSGIS car / driving; complete directed-leg ferry audit
nearestBeaches.method: The cached 20-source/38-destination table compares the 19 supported corridors using explicit source-row indices. Each fixed Pune-through-ghat prefix is added to exit-to-beach model distance. The union of ten candidates per ghat and five distinct primary corridors per beach receives full route or exact complete-leg assembly audits. Extra candidates below actual selection boundaries are audited until no unevaluated numeric candidate is shorter. Order uses actual full-trip metres, choosing one best itinerary per requested main ghat, not every physically traversed approach ghat.
nearestBeaches.limitations: OSRM model-preferred fastest driving, not global shortest-distance optimization. Composed routes include explicit coastal access stops and sum complete forward-only source legs; they are not an independently optimized whole itinerary. Every leg has actual provider geometry/totals; no straight roads or reversed one-way legs. Table costs may include ferries and waypoint-turn differences; selected routes use audited mainland bypasses. Audited but omitted candidates may have lower provisional numeric costs than their actual ferry-free/stop-constrained totals. Static desk snapshot only, not current road-opening, legal-access, parking or safety verification.

beachExpansion.arrivalDefinition: Car-road snaps near access; never sand driving or a parking guarantee.

adjacencyGraph.meaning: Requested primary-ghat corridor to beach itinerary edges; traversed approach ghats are annotations, never extra independent alternatives. Highway variants are excluded.
